title: Don’t cheat! Your budget is $10. Who will you choose for the 2026 season? 💸✨
description:
Don’t cheat! Your budget is $10. Who will you choose for the 2026 season? 💸✨ The character select screen is now live. Will you go all-in on raw power or aim for a well-rounded team? Remember: if you overspend, your gains don't count!
 The Price List: 
$5 Elite Tier: 
#1 Hybrid, 
#2 Heavy Hitter,
 #3 Pilates Pro, 
#4 Calisthenics King
 $3 Specialist Tier: 
#6 Functional Rebel, Classic Bodybuilder
 $2 Foundation Tier: 
Track Star, Zen Master
 My $10 Build: I’m choosing  for raw strength,  for the engine, and  because we are prioritizing mobility! 🎯 What’s your squad? Share your choices below! 👇🏾
